tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background for every outside screen (landing, /start, /buyer, /sell, /market, /lot). Never on /floor.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, nav, sheets. Sits on canvas with a line border, no shadow by default.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a card: the goal preview, a code block, a table header.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The one text colour. Headings, numbers, body. Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table cells.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, labels. 4.9:1 on surface in light, 6.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, rows and inputs. Thin borders instead of shadows.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger border for focused inputs, dividers inside dense tables and the phone shell.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The living pulse: one action colour for the outside, the Shield colour on the floor. Links, the active state, status dots, the ring glow. 5.6:1 on surface light, 6.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: pulse-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a pulse fill.

tokens.name: pulse-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an active row, a LIVE pill, the selected tab.

tokens.name: pulse-glow
tokens.usage: The outer ring of a pulsing dot and the box-shadow of the one active card. Never on text.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Good: approved, verified fit, verified_stable, paid, no recall. Always with its word.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a mint pill or a checker tick.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Bad: eaten, vetoed, blocked, denied, recall match. Always with its word.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a coral pill, the eaten row.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Caution: SIM label, uncertain fit, stale price, env-gated. Always with its word.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an amber pill.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Neutral state: sealed, pending, MIRROR, settled history.

tokens.name: slate-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a slate pill.

tokens.name: royal
tokens.usage: The CRS referee only: the referee row, the referee call on the floor, the CRS check line in a receipt.

tokens.name: royal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the referee pill.

tokens.name: floor-bg
tokens.usage: The /floor page background, both themes. The floor is always dark.

tokens.name: floor-ground
tokens.usage: The ring mat, drawn in three-quarter perspective.

tokens.name: floor-line
tokens.usage: White line art: ring edges, posts, HUD rules, crowd silhouettes at 40 percent.

tokens.name: floor-rope
tokens.usage: The three ropes on each side, 2 px, 70 percent opacity for the back ropes.

tokens.name: floor-post-a
tokens.usage: Front-left and back-right ring post caps (orange, as on the CRS booth ring).

tokens.name: floor-post-b
tokens.usage: Front-right and back-left ring post caps (purple, as on the CRS booth ring).

tokens.name: pac
tokens.usage: The buyer agent (Pac-Man). The only yellow in the product.

tokens.name: pac-shade
tokens.usage: Pac-Man's lower-half shade and its outline on the mat.

tokens.name: ghost-1
tokens.usage: Seller 1 sprite.

tokens.name: ghost-2
tokens.usage: Seller 2 sprite.

tokens.name: ghost-3
tokens.usage: Seller 3 sprite.

tokens.name: ghost-4
tokens.usage: Seller 4 sprite.

tokens.name: ghost-eaten
tokens.usage: An eaten seller: body fades to this, only the eyes float off.

tokens.name: ghost-blue
tokens.usage: The survivor after the checker tick: it grows and turns this blue (classic Pac-Man blue), then walks out with the buyer.

tokens.name: referee
tokens.usage: The CRS referee sprite stripes and its call banner on the floor (royal, dark theme value).

tokens.name: shield
tokens.usage: The Shield hexagon on the floor (pulse, dark theme value). The one colour both worlds share at the same value.

tokens.name: checker
tokens.usage: The checker tick and its FIT OK label on the floor.

tokens.name: tag-bg
tokens.usage: Price tag fill over a seller sprite.

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: Price tag text.

tokens.name: crowd
tokens.usage: Crowd silhouettes along the bottom edge of the floor.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero only, 1440. Drops to display-lg at 390.

styles.name: number-hero
styles.usage: The one hero number per screen: the deal price, the saving, the allowance.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Card titles that carry a moment (approval, receipt).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page titles inside the buyer app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: No seller sees your budget or another bid.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Dated MIRROR price from Best Buy, Oct 24.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, pill text, table heads.

styles.name: code-lg
styles.usage: The spoken approval code on the approval card. Nothing else.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices in rows and tags; tabular figures.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Charge references, mandate hashes, agent addresses, timestamps.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: The floor HUD line. Never under 11 px, never on the outside.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: The one-word floor callouts: SEALED, REVEAL, EATEN, BLOCKED, FIT OK, WINNER.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, pill padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills, inside dense rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pill padding-x, row padding-y.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding at 390, page gutter at 390 (never less).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding at 1440.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards, between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section gap at 390.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Landing section padding at 1440.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero top padding at 1440.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width on the landing and buyer screens; the floor is full-bleed.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, code wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, rows inside a card, the chat bubble.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards. The default radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hero mock, the ASI:One picture-in-picture frame, the phone shell.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting card. Mostly the border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The ASI:One picture-in-picture frame, open menus, the approval sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The one active card or the focused input. Never two glows on one screen.

timing.note: Motion is subtle on the outside and purposeful on the floor. Every duration is in ms; every ease is one of two curves.

tokens.name: t-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, pill colour change, focus ring.

tokens.name: t-base
tokens.usage: Card enter (fade + 8 px rise), tab switch.

tokens.name: t-slow
tokens.usage: Sheet open, number ticker settle, approval success check.

tokens.name: t-pulse
tokens.usage: The status dot pulse period (ring scales 1 to 2.2 and fades). Infinite, paused under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: t-ticker
tokens.usage: Number count-up on a hero number, ease-out, once on mount.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or settles.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Floor dashes and walks; the only other curve.

tokens.name: f-reveal
tokens.usage: Floor: a price tag flips from SEALED to its price. Stagger 120 ms per seller.

tokens.name: f-dash
tokens.usage: Floor: Pac-Man dashes to the seller it will eat (ease-in-out).

tokens.name: f-chomp
tokens.usage: Floor: three mouth cycles while the ghost fades to ghost-eaten and its eyes float up 40 px over 600 ms.

tokens.name: f-block
tokens.usage: Floor: the Shield hexagon slides in from the referee's side and flashes twice (120 ms each).

tokens.name: f-wander
tokens.usage: Floor: each ghost drifts between random points on the mat with this period, ease-in-out, with a 2 px bob at 400 ms.

tokens.name: f-grow
tokens.usage: Floor: the survivor scales 1 to 1.6 and tints to ghost-blue (ease-out).

tokens.name: f-walkout
tokens.usage: Floor: the buyer and the survivor walk out under the front rope, toward the camera and right.
